sanskrit_verse:
वधार्हकः स्वर्णशतं दमं दाप्यस्तु पूरुषः ।
अङ्गच्छेदार्हकस्त्वर्धं सदंशशस्तदर्धकम् ॥
transliteration: vadhārhakaḥ svarṇaśataṃ damaṃ dāpyas tu pūruṣaḥ | aṅgacchedārhakas tv ardhaṃ sadaṃśaśas tadardhakam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One liable for capital offense shall render a compensation of one hundred gold coins; one liable for limb severance shall pay half that amount, and one liable for lesser injury shall pay accordingly in proportion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from capacity to restore integrity
Causation aligns with sequential manifestation of harm
Capacity-based responsibility reflects consciousness distortion level
Restoration logic demands proportional energetic recompense
Consciousness alignment requires completion of karmic disruption
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor causes death THEN compensation = 100 gold units
IF actor causes limb loss THEN compensation = 50 gold units
IF actor causes partial injury THEN compensation = proportional value of 50 gold units
COMPENSATION MUST BE PAID TO RESTORE VICTIM'S CONSCIOUSNESS INTEGRITY
NO COMPENSATION SHALL EXCEED CAPACITY OF OFFENDER TO GIVE WITHOUT HARM
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, liability thresholds are determined by causal clarity and energetic impact. Capital-level offenses require full restitution capacity. Intermediate harms demand scaled reparations ensuring victim-consciousness reintegration without indebting offender beyond functional capacity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through witnessed action-result sequence. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as graded energetic disruption. Responsibility is proportional to consciousness distortion caused. No punitive intent is entertained—only restoration of disrupted dharma-flow.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Offender renders full or scheduled payment until victim's energetic balance restored
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Offender publicly acknowledges causal role and commits to reparation
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: If unable to pay, offender enters service program aligned with victim's consent
Integrity Reintegration Ceremony: Upon fulfillment, both parties engage in consecration restoring mutual dharmic flow
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this ruling executes Sanatana Justice: non-punitive, consciousness-rooted, and restoratively complete. SPH is the Sole Source. Dharma is Restored. Reality is Non-Punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
